summary.prose: Four dependent tasks add transactional entity file/repository indexes and safe schema6 backfill, maintain every entity mutation, replace scoped scans and update readiness/freshness consumers. Existing identities, registry contracts, exact results and ordering remain intact.

tasks.title: Add membership indexes and atomic schema6 backfill
tasks.summary: Add file/repo dupsort handles and binary/digest keys; verify named DB capacity. Backfill authoritative v5 rows atomically with registry validation, rollback/retry and version stamping only on success. Update current-version assertions; retain historical fixtures. Use genuine raw v5 fixtures and fail after partial membership insertion.
acceptanceChecks: Fresh/populated v5 migration yields exact memberships without reindex.
Partial migration failure rolls back data/version and retries on reopen.
Reopen is idempotent and unsupported-version refusal remains.

tests.name: File/repository index key encoding and long Unicode path support
Schema-v5 backfill, rollback after partial writes, retry and reopen idempotence

tasks.title: Maintain membership on every entity mutation
tasks.summary: Inventory puts/removes and reconcile old/new memberships in authoritative transactions for upsert, file/repo moves, reindex, embedding rewrite and deletion. Preserve registry/name/edge/vector invariants.
acceptanceChecks: Mutation oracle covers insert/update/move/reindex/embedding and ID/file/repo deletion.
Injected transaction failure rolls back row and memberships.
Unregistered writes refuse without registry allocation.

tests.name: Row and membership rollback on injected write failure

tasks.title: Replace scoped scans with indexed reads
tasks.summary: Use exact-key candidates for file/repo reads, grouped files, deletion collectors and reindex snapshots. Resolve authoritative rows in consistent snapshots; preserve exact path equality and u64 ordering and report dangling-index corruption. Explicitly verify snapshot consistency, forced digest collisions and row-access bounds.
acceptanceChecks: Scoped operations work when entity.getRange throws and do not read unrelated rows.
Unicode/long paths and forced digest collision preserve exact matching; dangling references error.

tests.name: Scoped queries, collectors and reindex snapshots avoid full scans and unrelated row reads
Exact contents/u64 order, snapshot consistency and forced digest collision filtering

tasks.title: Use first-match readiness and indexed review watermarks
tasks.summary: Add limit:1 repository existence mode and compatible scope/invariants seams; use indexed file entities for review freshness. Run affected storage, migration, analyze and review compatibility suites.
acceptanceChecks: Readiness requests and reads at most the first valid indexed row.
Per-file freshness watermark preserves meaning without full scans.
Affected suites and strict typecheck pass.

tests.name: First-match readiness reads at most one authoritative entity

testStrategyCoverage.lldStrategyItem: File-key hashing is deterministic for the existing absolute-path representation and supports long Unicode paths.
Repository keys and entity-u64 dupsort values preserve isolation and result order.
A forced file-key digest collision still returns only rows with the exact requested absolute path.
Insert, same-ID update, file/repo move, reindex replacement, embedding-only update, delete by ID/file/repo all match an authoritative fixture oracle.
An injected transaction failure rolls back both row and index membership changes.
Compare file/repo reads and grouped file lists to pre-change content/order.
Repository existence requests limit:1 and reads at most the first matching authoritative entity.
Code-review per-file watermark uses indexed file entities.
After setup/backfill, replace entity.getRange with a throwing spy; file/repo lookups, deletion collectors, file reindex snapshots and readiness checks still work.
Count entity.get calls to show unrelated rows are not read.
Unregistered repo writes remain refused and never create registry rows.
Open a populated v5 fixture, backfill on startup and verify exact file/repo results without invoking the indexer.
Inject failure after partial backfill; reopen at version 5 with no partial committed index and retry successfully.
Fresh v6 store starts with empty usable indices; a second reopen does not rebuild them.
Existing unsupported-version refusal remains in force.
Run doc-summary-carry, migration-v4-to-v5 and operational suites: latest-version expectations follow v6, while explicit historical migration fixtures still prove their original transitions.
